page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: "Theologia Iudaica" with page number 475 at top right. Below a rule, a running line "Num.Præceptor." left and "Cap.VI." right. Main text in one column of numbered precepts, each with a marginal reference at the right (ib. and numbers) and a left-margin abbreviation (Non, Obf., N.obf., Obferv.). The marginal references are notes beside their lines.

main_text.p: Non329 Non putabis in anno Jubilæi arborem, nec terram excoles. ib. 12
N.obf.330 Non metes Iponte natum in anno Jubilæi. ib. 12
N.obf.331 Non congregabis in Jubilæo frustum de arbore. ib. 12
Observ.332 Obiervabis iustitiam inter mercatores. ib. 14
Observ.333 Non circumvenies hominem in pecuniis. ib. 17
N.obf.335 Non vendes agrum in terra sancta in æternum. ib. 23
N.obf.336 Dabis redemptionem terræ secundum legem. ib. 24
N.obf.337 Ut sit redemptio domus murorum cinctæ in civitate usque ad annum. ib. 29
N.obf.338 Agrum suburbanum Levitarum non vendes, & rediment illum sive ante sive post Jubilæum. ib. 34
Observ.339 Non accipies pecuniam in usuram. 25.37
Observ.340 Non affliges fratrem tuum duriter. ib. 39
Observ.341 Non vendes illum venditione perpetua. ib. 39
Observ.342 Ne exerceas in eum dominium per sævitiam. ib. 43

page.notes: Marginal references are read as printed and may be partly doubtful; "Non" at top left is a catchword-like abbreviation for the first line. Some abbreviations in the left margin (Obf., Observ.) are uncertain. Line 337 and 338 are partly reconstructed from the print and marked for checking.
